qualification: Pre-fix trun parsing accepted 0x00_0004 (first-sample-flags-present) and 0x00_0400 (sample-flags-present) simultaneously, reading both fields from the box payload and silently discarding first_sample_flags in favor of row[0]'s sample_flags. Pre-fix baseline passed 3/3 controls and both forced acceptance gates failed specifically because 0x00_0405 runs indexed and reached native VP9 playback.

Validating that flags & 0x00_0004 != 0 and flags & 0x00_0400 != 0 are never combined refuses all 4 malformed cases (both populated sync/non-sync contradictions, late third-fragment contradiction, and empty-run contradiction) as Error::Invalid ('MP4 track-run states both first-sample flags and per-sample flags') before publishing samples or admitting native decoders.

All 5 healthy controls (regular MP4, default tfhd/trex flags, first-sample-only, per-sample-only, and first-sample-lead-sync) retain exact coded packets, sync flags, 50 Hz clocks, sample/packet budgets, analytic 16x16 VP9 planes/RGB (128/130), 40 total public clamped seek targets, rewind, and repeated EOF.
4 focused tests, 62 related MP4/HLS/VP9 integration tests, 17 MP4 unit tests, 29 minimal-configuration (--no-default-features) tests, offline fixture generator unittest, and full player build pass.

ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015, 8.8.8 specifies that sample-flags-present shall not be set when first-sample-flags-present is set. All fixtures are pure synthetic offline VP9/fMP4 files requiring neither FFmpeg nor network access.
counting: One trun flag mutual-exclusion fix (FVID-0180). No extra IDs for fixture variants, controls, or generator.
